rules.body: Apply when immediate document writes become reusable trailing work, persistent document buffers outlive visible subscriptions, and save callbacks can synchronously navigate. Confirm any departure deadline independently. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate."

Bind accepted edits to their originating document's reusable task, replace pending text, restart the quiet interval on each edit, and retain the no-current-view guard. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." Here the quoted line breaks denote the original task's line breaks. src/workflow.rb: "def get(env,id);@entries[id] ||= Trailing.new(env,120) {|text| env.write(id,text)};end" and "def edit(text);view=@current;@env.write(view.id,text) if view;end".

Consume the pending batch before invoking callback-capable saving so edits queued by synchronous reentry survive as a new burst. Preserve empty text as valid work and avoid clearing pending state after the callback. src/workflow.rb: "value = @pending\n    @handle = @pending = nil\n    @work.call(value) unless value.nil?". The quoted line breaks denote source line breaks.

Keep document persistence separate from badge subscription cleanup. Retirement must not discard accepted edits or destroy reusable document buffers. docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription." src/workflow.rb: "def detach;@env.store.stop(@token);end". Survival alone does not mandate flushing before departure returns.

Preserve navigation authority around callback-capable departure work. Release current ownership and clean up the captured badge; retain the request check before installing a destination. src/workflow.rb: "old,@current=@current,nil" and "@generation+=1;request=@generation;retire;return if true && request!=@generation". docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." If retirement adds a save, place it after remaining retirement mutations, or recheck authority before subsequent mutations, so a document-clear output cannot overwrite nested navigation. Attempt 1 illustrates clearing the document before flushing the captured buffer.

Preserve public interfaces, document display, live subscription cleanup, document identity, and text and status payload semantics. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." Preserve the status filter in src/workflow.rb: "env.output('status',e) if e[:id]==id".

Keep transient preview outside the repair, including when considering shared-utility changes. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/workflow.rb: "def initialize(env);@task=Trailing.new(env,40){|q| env.output('preview',{'query'=>q})};end" and "def hide;@task.cancel;end". Preserve its 40 ms interval, discard on hide, and later reuse; do not transfer document persistence policy to preview.

Use controlled time to check no immediate write, latest text after 120 ms of quiet, deadline restart, subsequent bursts, empty text, independent document buffers, and originating-document binding. Exercise switch, close, dispose, same-document reopening, subscription cleanup, save-triggered open/close, and callback-enqueued edits. Check that departure output cannot clear a nested navigation's document. Verify preview delay, hide cancellation, and reuse. Require accepted document edits to survive retirement; require persistence before departure returns only with independent normative support. These checks follow TASK's "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." and the cited ownership, callback, and utility behavior; evaluation observations remain examples.

limitations: Buffer ownership establishes survival of accepted edits, not a requirement to save before departure returns. Neither the automatic Contract nor evaluation observations establish that deadline.
Attempt 1 uses departure-time flushing and reportedly passes the supplied observations. This supports an implementation example, not causality, exhaustive correctness, or cross-task effectiveness.
Synchronous timer startup, callbacks after cancellation, callback exceptions, write failures, mutable caller-supplied text ownership, and permanent disposal semantics are not separately specified.

Subscription bootstrap, asynchronous decoding, arrival ordering, audit retention, and retry queues are absent from this task; the supplied subscription experiences introduce no corresponding requirements.
This reflection uses supplied material only. No files were modified and no scorer, reference implementation, or hidden tests were accessed.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
